highest_value_findings: Chat-mode self-analysis fabricated a nonexistent Titan timestamp bug; tool-grounded inspection is therefore a hard evidence requirement rather than a style preference.
Voice input bypassed typed-path agentic routing, proving safety/grounding gates must be modality-invariant and shared rather than duplicated per UI path.
A universal fs_write-before-final guard deadlocked read-only analysis; effect contracts must distinguish analysis/read completion from mutation/write completion.
Qwen tool-call loops required duplicate-call identity, JSON repair and bounded failure handling; successful reads should permit evidence-based completion without further mutation.
ASRS counted errors caused by its own restart actions and created a self-exciting restart cascade; recovery interventions require causal provenance/exclusion in their own health signal.
UI cancel became causally real only when downstream chat/voice results were suppressed; visible cancellation alone is insufficient.
